items.title: Apple Q3 earnings, revenue exceed Wall Street estimates
items.summary: Apple (AAPL) released results for its fiscal third quarter, revealing earnings of $2.02 per share (vs. estimates of $1.80) and revenue of $109.42 billion (vs. estimates of $108.85 billion). The stock is ticking lower in Thursday's after-hours trading. Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton dives into Apple's earnings figures.

items.title: Chip stocks are rebounding — except for Qualcomm: Why it might just be a 'one off'
items.summary: Chip stocks are rebounding on Thursday, with the exception of Qualcomm (QCOM), which provided profit guidance that disappointed Wall Street. BD8 Capital Partners CEO and CIO Barbara Doran and Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley chat with Morning Brief host Julie Hyman about Qualcomm and the larger chip sector.

items.title: Big Tech earnings meet IPO buzz: What to watch Thursday
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton previews the biggest market catalysts for Thursday, July 30, including highly anticipated earnings from Apple (AAPL) and Amazon (AMZN) as well as the expected IPO debuts of Jersey Mike's and Reformation.

items.title: Strong iPhone sales propel Apple's fiscal Q3 results past Wall Street's expectations
items.summary: Apple posted a solid fiscal third quarter on Thursday, climbing past Wall Street's expectations thanks to strong sales of the iPhone and MacBook computers.  Apple raised the prices of its Macs and iPads last month, citing a memory-chip shortage brought on by the artificial intelligence boom.  The company had called the demand spike an “unprecedented challenge” for the consumer electronics industry.

items.title: Apple’s (NASDAQ:AAPL) Q2 CY2026 Sales Top Estimates
items.summary: iPhone and iPad maker Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 16.4% year on year to $109.4 billion. Its GAAP profit of $2.02 per share was 6.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
